label: A: экосистема+проверка+выбор
description: Search the open agent-skills ecosystem — the thousands of public repositories published by other people, which the built-in catalog search does not reach — then vet what it finds and load it. Use whenever the user asks for a skill, a tool or a capability for any topic: "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that…", names a repository or an owner to try, or asks you to extend your own abilities. Use it too before specialist work — infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, container orchestration, database migrations, testing strategy, framework-specific implementation, document or data tooling — when nothing already installed covers that domain. Beyond finding a candidate it checks install counts and source reputation before recommending anything, warns that a third-party skill runs with the agent's full permissions, and always offers the choice between installing it permanently and loading it for one session.
